# Empasy SyncSeries

> Empasy IT Corp. (주식회사 엠파시) develops modular enterprise software built on a shared standard foundation (`SyncBoot`, Java 25, Spring Boot 4.0, PostgreSQL 18.6) with Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) approval controls and on-premise deployment support.

## Overview
Empasy SyncSeries consists of 4 flagship solutions (`SyncVerse`, `SyncETA`, `SyncBoot`, `SyncCMS`) and 7 modular extensions organized across Data & AI, Security & Governance, and Operations & Commerce. Each module shares common authentication, permission, audit logging, and standard MCP/A2A integration protocols so organizations can start with a single product and expand step by step.

## Flagship Solutions (4)

### SyncVerse (Central Collaboration & Approval Oversight)
- Product Page: https://verse.empasy.io/
- Corporate Page: https://empasy.io/ko/solutions/sync-verse.html
- Docs: https://doc.empasy.com/syncverse/
- Role: Multi-agent workflow coordination, Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) approval gates, audit trace visibility, and operational stop controls.

### SyncETA (No-Code Automated E2E Testing & Desktop App)
- Product Page: https://eta.empasy.io/
- Corporate Page: https://empasy.io/ko/solutions/sync-eta.html
- Desktop Download: https://empasy.io/ko/download_eta.html
- Live Demo Portal: https://sync.empasy.io/products/sync-eta
- Architecture Guide: https://empasy.io/ko/blog/synceta-intelligent-regression-testing-pipeline.html
- Docs: https://doc.empasy.com/synceta/
- Role (KO): 코딩 없이 마우스 클릭이나 자연어·엑셀 기반으로 E2E 테스트 시나리오를 구성하고, UI 변경 시 문맥 기반 셀렉터 자동 보정(Self-Healing)과 배포 전후 화면 비교 리포트를 제공하는 자동 테스트 플랫폼입니다.
- Role (EN): Desktop and web E2E UI test automation platform combining Playwright execution, context-aware selector recovery when UI elements change, and visual comparison reports.

### SyncBoot (Enterprise Back-Office Core Platform)
- Product Page: https://boot.empasy.io/
- Corporate Page: https://empasy.io/ko/solutions/sync-boot.html
- Docs: https://doc.empasy.com/syncboot/
- Role: Standard enterprise back-office core built on Spring Boot 4.0 and Java 25 with SSO, Org/Role/Menu/Button RBAC, electronic approval workflows, audit logs, and standard administrative screens.

### SyncCMS (Website & Multilingual Content Management)
- Product Page: https://cms.empasy.io/
- Corporate Page: https://empasy.io/ko/solutions/sync-cms.html
- Docs: https://doc.empasy.com/synccms/
- Role: Nuxt 3 SSR hybrid CMS supporting draft review workflows, pre-publication content inspection, and multilingual site publishing.

## Modular Extensions (7)

### Data & AI (3)
- **SyncInsight** (https://insight.empasy.io/ | https://doc.empasy.com/syncinsight/): Read-only natural-language data query (NL2SQL) and analytical reporting within enterprise access permissions.
- **SyncLLM** (https://llm.empasy.io/ | https://doc.empasy.com/syncllm/): Multi-LLM gateway supporting departmental token budget controls, `pgvector` semantic caching, PII masking, and local model routing (vLLM, Ollama).
- **SyncCrawl** (https://crawl.empasy.io/ | https://doc.empasy.com/synccrawl/): Scheduled web data extraction with layout-change resilience, `robots.txt` compliance, and structured vector/database outputs.

### Security & Governance (2)
- **SyncAPIM** (https://apim.empasy.io/ | https://doc.empasy.com/syncapim/): API inventory tracking, contract drift inspection, security policy monitoring, and response PII protection.
- **SyncWatch** (https://watch.empasy.io/ | https://doc.empasy.com/syncwatch/): Security vulnerability feed aggregation (NVD CVE, CISA KEV, OSV, KISA) and rule distribution for SyncVerse and SyncAPIM.

### Operations & Commerce (2)
- **SyncShop** (https://shop.empasy.io/ | https://doc.empasy.com/syncshop/): 8-service distributed microservices (MSA) e-commerce platform with margin-aware pricing controls, order/settlement operations, and semantic product search.
- **SyncOps** (https://ops.empasy.io/ | https://doc.empasy.com/syncops/): Enterprise SI PMO platform supporting contract vs. actual cost P&L tracking, KOSA engineer grade management, surety bond tracking, and electronic R&D lab notebooks.

## Deployment & Security
- Deployments: On-premise servers, isolated internal networks (air-gapped), and dedicated VPC environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).
- Local LLMs: Compatible with local runtimes including vLLM, Ollama, TGI, and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
- Governance: Role-based access control, PII masking, and full execution audit logs.
